title: Feedback
creator: bexdowney
content:
1. 1 there should be an option to put the menu with the delete button at the bottom, not top.
  2. 2 Unified inbox is great, but why not unified everything. Unified spam,.sent, deleted etc. Blue mail does it and it's very useful.

Those are the 2 main things. Anything else is not important but nice. E.g.

  1. 3 Options for a bit more colour or ability to colour things, like accounts or senders.
  2. 4 One click unsubscribe for emails

Other than that it's utterly awesome and feels very stable, unlike the new release of Blue Mail.
